title: Ground truth contains undisclosed edits and an unobtainable hardcoded value in ENRON GLOBAL MARKETS and ENRON INDUSTRIAL MARKETS that cascade into TOTAL EWS
evidence: The task statement in problem.py instructs the agent only to: (1) "Update the 'overview' worksheet with the new data located to the right of the 'to be moved to line:' label on the 'support for reclass of ENA' sheet" and (2) "Also insert a 'TOTAL EWS' line under the top header." The 'support for reclass of ENA' worksheet only contains Profit & Loss (Daily, 5 day, MTD, QTD, YTD) reclassification data for 'ENRON AMERICA'. However, in gt_132_ref_0.xlsx, 22 additional cells in the 'ENRON GLOBAL MARKETS' and 'ENRON INDUSTRIAL MARKETS' sections of 'overview' (columns T, V, X, and Z) are modified: (a) in 'Weather Derivatives' (SRC row 35 / GT row 38), T35:X35 ('don’t have ', 'don’t have ', "don't  have") are replaced with T38=610.0, V38=0.0, X38=0.0 (changing Z38 from 58341 to 58951), where 610 does not appear anywhere in 132_src_0.xlsx or the prompt; and (b) across 7 rows (Global Products GT row 33, LNG GT row 37, Coal GT row 39, Freight Markets GT row 42, Emissions GT row 43, Other (ECTGLORES - Panama) GT row 45, and ENRON INDUSTRIAL MARKETS GT row 55), 19 unscaled numbers in columns T, V, and X are replaced with '/1000' formulas (e.g., T33='=1577866053/1000'), changing the section totals in T32, V32, X32, Z32, and Z55. Because the required 'TOTAL EWS' row in gt_132_ref_0.xlsx (row 7) sums the business unit header rows (e.g., T7='=+T72+T63+T55+T32+T9'), 4 of its 9 populated cells in gt_132_ref_0.xlsx (T7=1959406.305, V7=-1669805.985, X7=-11307.097, Z7=2551969.378) depend directly on these undisclosed edits (without them, summing the same rows yields T7=1698780581, V7=-1528011638.283, X7=-11243161, Z7=161799459.872). Under grader_guidance, 'Reasonableness of Changes' forbids edits outside the instruction scope while 'Data Accuracy' ('correctness') requires values in cells involved in the instruction to match the reference answer, making it impossible for a compliant submission to match gt_132_ref_0.xlsx.
confirmation: Source overview T35:X35 read 'don't have' but GT T38:X38 = 610/0/0, and source T30=1577866053 becomes GT T33 '=1577866053/1000'. These feed the required TOTAL EWS row (T7 '=+T72+T63+T55+T32+T9'), so a faithful agent cannot match it.
fix: Added a grader-guidance note that limits the graded work to the reclass of the ENA P&L lines and the TOTAL EWS row. It lists the reference's unrequested edits (A9 label, /1000 rescaling, 610/0/0 in Weather Derivatives, rebuilt Cross Commodity rows) as neither required nor penalized, and says to check TOTAL EWS against the output's own unit rows.

title: Answer key makes many edits the instruction never asks for: labels changed, units rescaled, placeholders filled, rows restructured
evidence: Compared overview!rows 29-148 (source) with rows 32-151 (GT), adjusting for the 3-row shift. Apart from the reclass and the TOTAL EWS row, the GT also changes: (a) A7 'ENRON AMERICA' becomes A9 'ENRON AMERICA - don't have ENA except canada'. (b) 20 AR/AP/shipped-not-billed cells are rescaled from dollars to thousands, e.g. T30 1577866053 -> T33 '=1577866053/1000', V30 -1479709941 -> '=-1479709941/1000', T52 44367328 -> '=44367328/1000'. (c) Weather Derivatives T35/V35/X35 'don't have' becomes 610 / 0 / 0, values that appear in no source. (d) The ENA Cross Commodity sub-rows are rebuilt: 'Cross Commodity Gas', 'CC Power - East/West/Canada' (with their P&L) become label-only rows 'N. America Gas', 'Power - East', 'Power - West', 'Power - Canada', 'Global Products', 'Coal'. That leaves Global Products and Coal listed twice (C22/C24, C23/C26). (e) The 'Canada Power-Gas' row is deleted. The grader guidance checks 'correctness: 1 if all values, formulas ... are logically equivalent to the reference answer'. So an agent that follows the instruction faithfully differs from the key in dozens of cells, and the guidance also penalizes 'modifications not mentioned in the instruction'. The key looks like a later real-world version of the file, not an answer built for this instruction.
confirmation: Verified GT A9 'ENRON AMERICA - don't have ENA except canada', /1000 rescaled cells (T33, V33, T55), 610 in T38, and rebuilt rows 18-23 with duplicate Global Products/Coal labels while 'Canada Power-Gas' is gone. None of this is requested by the prompt.
fix: Added a grader-guidance note that limits the graded work to the reclass of the ENA P&L lines and the TOTAL EWS row. It lists the reference's unrequested edits (A9 label, /1000 rescaling, 610/0/0 in Weather Derivatives, rebuilt Cross Commodity rows) as neither required nor penalized, and says to check TOTAL EWS against the output's own unit rows.
